note: 30 epochs barely moved the loss (5.87 at 5 epochs to 5.72). 1vsAll CE treats every non-target entity as negative, and in a dense co-occurrence graph most of those are true neighbours. The model is not fit for this graph without a contrastive/positive-sampling objective. The w2v export bug that broke the first attempt is fixed in tranz commit 24b682e (binary+vocab export).
